title: American Cement Association supports Bipartisan American Affordability and Jobs Act of 2026
summary: American Cement Association supports Bipartisan American Affordability and Jobs Act of 2026
body_markdown:
**US:** The American Cement Association (ACA) has urged the US House of Representatives to pass the Bipartisan American Affordability and Jobs Act of 2026 (BAAJA). The legislation aims to set timelines for federal environmental reviews, streamline Clean Water Act permitting and provide greater certainty once projects are approved. The bill passed the US Senate by 62 votes to 33 on 20 November 2026.


In a statement dated 20 November 2026, The ACA called permitting reform a ‘national necessity.’ it encouraged the House to bring BAAJA to the floor and send it to President Trump before the end of the current Congress on 3 January 2027.
